note: Submodule of Dashboards. Provides one Dashboard plugin, node_most_readed ('Show most visited.', category Statistics), a chart of page views per content type from core Statistics' node_counter table (settings key 'count' = totalcount|daycount). Exposed as block dashboards_block:dashboard:node_most_readed, placed in a dashboard's Layout Builder. Medium/hard cases build/read a dashboard whose section contains that widget block (and its count setting), verified by loading the dashboard storage and scanning section component configuration via drush.

evals.prompt: What dashboard widget does the dashboards_statistic submodule provide, and what does it show?
evals.expected_output: The 'node_most_readed' Dashboard plugin ('Show most visited.', category Statistics): a chart of page views per content type sourced from core Statistics' node_counter table.

evals.prompt: As which block plugin id is the dashboards_statistic most-visited widget placed onto a dashboard?
evals.expected_output: It is placed as block dashboards_block:dashboard:node_most_readed in the dashboard's Layout Builder.

evals.prompt: Which setting on the dashboards_statistic widget picks all-time versus daily view counts, and what are the values?
evals.expected_output: The 'count' setting: 'totalcount' (all-time) or 'daycount' (today) selects which node_counter column is summed per node type.

evals.prompt: On this site a dashboard (id ds_probe) has been built with a dashboards_statistic widget. Inspect the dashboard configuration and give the block plugin id of the statistics widget it contains.
evals.expected_output: ds_probe contains block dashboards_block:dashboard:node_most_readed. Read via `drush cget dashboards.dashboard.ds_probe` or by scanning the dashboard's sections.

evals.prompt: Inspect the ds_probe dashboard and report the 'count' setting configured on its dashboards_statistic most-visited widget.
evals.expected_output: The node_most_readed component on ds_probe has count = daycount.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a dashboard with machine id 'ds_task_a' and add the dashboards_statistic most-visited widget (block dashboards_block:dashboard:node_most_readed) to it in a Layout Builder section. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Dashboard ds_task_a exists with a Layout Builder section component whose configuration id is 'dashboards_block:dashboard:node_most_readed'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a dashboard with machine id 'ds_task_b' containing the dashboards_statistic widget (dashboards_block:dashboard:node_most_readed) configured to show DAILY view counts (count setting 'daycount'). Apply it live.
evals.expected_output: Dashboard ds_task_b has a dashboards_block:dashboard:node_most_readed component whose configuration.count === 'daycount'.
